title: Gemini Fixed 1000 Chrome Bugs in One Month
description:
Gemini patched more Chrome holes in one month than humans managed in two years 😳

Across two Chrome releases the AI closed around a thousand vulnerabilites. It finds the flaw in the code and ships the fix on the spot 🔥

Microsoft hit its own record with AI too. Apple, no big AI code audit, no simmilar jump. Years of work now fit in one release ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
